Approval authority by grade

Max Approval Authority is the largest amount a person of this grade can approve for others. Every eligible employee may request any advance amount, regardless of grade or previous outstanding advances.

Advance requests start with the immediate reporting manager. At each review, approval authority is checked against the employee's live total outstanding advances, including the current request. If the total exceeds their authority, they review and escalate to the next person in Reports To, one step at a time. Linked reviewers are not skipped. No employee may approve their own request.

Set the band on Employee → Grade. Designation remains the job title. Board of Directors has unlimited approval authority. Unlisted grades fall back to built-in defaults.
